description: Elaborati i signalizacije uređenja prometa i zimske službe is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Gračac. Traffic studies, signalling and equipment studies, winter services. Coverage: Općina Gračac. The portal shows the English title as "Study and signalization of traffic regulation and winter service" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Gračac. Its keywords include cestovni promet. The listing shows 5 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
